inputs.text: A baby stopped breathing while stuck with his family in a crowded TSA line at JFK on Thursday, and an ICE agent stepped in. DHS has released video emphasizing the agent’s response, but a dramatic rescue shouldn’t distract from the basic duty of public institutions to keep families safe in crowded spaces. No one should have to depend on a split-second intervention when a vulnerable child is in danger.
